F IFTH AMENDMENT 
 to Project Promotion Agreement by and between 
 Zameen Media (Private) Limited (“Zameen Media”) and Zameen Medallion (Private) Limited (“Zameen Medallion”) (Zameen Media and Zameen Medallion shall hereinafter collectively be referred to as “Zameen” ) and ZSS Developers ( hereinafter referred to as “Customer " ) 
 [Each a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”] 
 This fi fth amendment (“ First Amendment ”) to the Project Promotion Agreement dated 14 th November 202 2 , as amended by First Amendment dated 5 th April 2023, Second Amendment dated 2 nd June 2023, First Addendum dated 3 rd October 2023, Third Amendment dated 15 th January 2024 and Fourth Amendment dated 18 th April 2024 (“ Agreement ”) is made and entered into at Lahore on this 19 th April 202 4 (“ Effective Date ”) . 
 WHEREAS 
 The Parties entered into the Agreement for the performance of Services by Zameen with respect to the real estate project, named and styled as ‘ Boulevard Heights ’, comprising one ( 1 ) tower B + G+ 6 floors consisting of one hundred twenty-eight ( 128 ) residential apartments , two hundred and thirty-three ( 233 ) shops and sixteen (16) kiosks based on a total area of approximately 1 acre and located at Plot No. CD-04, Sector D, DHA, Multan (“ Project ”); and 
 
 Pursuant to Clause 12.1 of the Agreement, Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Agreement as per the provisions of this Fi fth Amendment. 
 NOW, THEREFORE , the Parties agree as f o l l ows: 
 The Fi fth Amendment shall be effective from the Effective Date. 
 Clause 1 . 6 of the Agreement is revised and replaced as follows: 
 “1.6 Inventory means, out of the total three hundred eighty-nine (3 89 ) Units in the Project, ninety-six ( 96 ) residential apartments, two hundred thirty-three {233) shops , twenty-four ( 24 ) kiosks and thirty-six (36) food courts/restaurants are available for the Zameen to sell, as listed in Annexure A. While the number of Units in the Project may vary as a result of structural reorganization, the square footage of the Project (Annexure F) shall remain unchanged. Any additional residential apartments or shops in the Project sold by Zameen as well as any Units created as a result of the aforementioned structural reorganization of the Project shall be deemed to be a part of the Inventory in Annexure A. 
 The Inventory specified in Annexure A of the Agreement is hereby revised and replaced with the Inventory specified in Annexure A/ 5 appended to this Fi fth Amendment. For the avoidance of doubt, the Inventory in Annexure A shall have no force or effect as of the Effective Date. Any references to Annexure A in the Agreement shall be deemed to be a reference to Annexure A/ 5 appended to this Fi fth Amendment . 
 The Price Schedule specified in Annexure B of the Agreement is hereby revised and replaced with the Price Schedule specified in Annexure B / 5 appended to this Fi fth Amendment. For the avoidance of doubt, the Price Schedule in Annexure B shall have no force or effect as of the Effective Date. Any references to Annexure B in the Agreement shall be deemed to be a reference to Annexure B / 5 appended to this Fi fth Amendment . 
 The Buyer’s Payment Plan in Annexure C of the Agreement is hereby revised and replaced by the Buyer’s Payment Plans specified in Annexure C / 5 appended to this Fi fth Amendment. For the avoidance of doubt, Buyer’s Payment Plans in Annexure C of the Agreement have no force or effect as of the Effective Date. A ny references to Annexure C in the Agreement shall be deemed to be a reference to Annexure C / 5 appended to this Fi fth Amendment. 
 The Services in Annexure D of the Agreement are hereby revised and replaced by the Services specified in Annexure D/5 appended to this Fifth Amendment. For the avoidance of doubt, Services in Annexure D of the Agreement have no force or effect as of the Effective Date. Any references to Annexure D in the Agreement shall be deemed to be a reference to Annexure D/5 appended to this Fifth Amendment. 
 The Sales Targets in Annexure E of the Agreement are hereby revised and replaced by the Sales Targets specified in Annexure E/ 5 appended to this Fi fth Amendment. For the avoidance of doubt, Sales Targets in Annexure E of the Agreement have no force or effect as of the Effective Date. Any references to Annexure E in the Agreement shall be deemed to be a reference to Annexure E/ 5 appended to this Fi fth Amendment. 
 The Project F loor P lan s in Annexure F of the Agreement are hereby revised and replaced by the Project F loor P lan s specified in Annexure F/ 5 appended to this Fi fth Amendment. For the avoidance of doubt, Project Floor Plans in Annexure F of the Agreement have no force or effect as of the Effective Date. Any references to Annexure F in the Agreement shall be deemed to be a reference to Annexure F/ 5 appended to this Fi fth Amendment . 
 The Schedule of Work in Annexure J of the Agreement is hereby revised and replaced by the Schedule of Work specified in Annexure J/ 5 appended to this Fi fth Amendment. For the avoidance of doubt, the Schedule of Work in Annexure J of the Agreement has no force or effect as of the Effective Date. Any references to Annexure J in the Agreement shall be deemed to be a reference to Annexure J / 5 appended to this Fi fth Amendment. 
 Clause 5.1 of the Agreement is revised and replaced as follows: 
 “As consideration for the Services performed by Zameen under this Agreement and utilization of Zameen’s online portal, Zameen shall be entitled to a fee equal to thirteen percent (1 3 %) of the Sale Price of all Units sold during the Service Period of the Agreement (“ Service Fee ”). ” 
 Clause 2.2 of the Agreement is hereby revised and replaced as follows: 
 “2.2 The Parties are entering into this Agreement whereby Zameen Media shall have the exclusive rights for the provision of Services or any other service related thereto, with respect to the Inventory, and Zameen Medallion shall have the right to collect from the Buyers, on behalf of the Customer, the down payment up to thirty-t hree percent (3 3 %) of the Sale Price of Unit(s) sold by Zameen and disbursement of payments to the Parties accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement.” 
 Clause 6.5 of the Agreement is hereby revised and replaced as follows: 
 “6.5 In respect of the Services, Zameen shall achieve periodical sales targets under this Agreement as fully defined in Annexure E (“ Sales Targets ”). Provided that the Sales Targets will commence subject to the fulfilment of obligations by the Customer under Clauses 6.1 and 9.17. Any delay on the part of the Customer with respect to the aforementioned clauses shall result in an automatic extension of time allotted to the Sales Targets and the Service Period of this Agreement which shall be at least equal to the time of delay on the part of the Customer.” 
 
 Clause 8.1. 1 of the Agreement is hereby revised and replaced as follows: 
 “8.1.3 Customer shall pay four percent ( 4 %) of the Sale Price to Zameen on payment of eleven percent (1 1 %) of the Sale Price by the Buyer ; 
 
 Clause 8.1. 2 of the Agreement is hereby revised and replaced as follows: 
 “8.1.3 Customer shall pay a five percent (5%) of the Sale Price to Zameen on payment of further eleven percent (1 1 %) of the Sale Price by the Buyer, taking the aggregate down payment/instalment(s) to twenty-two ( 22 %) of the Sale Price.” 
 
 Clause 8.1.3 of the Agreement is hereby revised and replaced as follows: 
 “8.1.3 Customer shall pay a further f ive percent ( 4 %) of the Sale Price, along with Zameen’s Share of Premium (if any) due under the terms of this Agreement, to Zameen on payment of further t hirteen percent (1 1 %) of the Sale Price by the Buyer, taking the aggregate down payment/instalment(s) to thirty-three percent (3 3 %) of the Sale Price.” 
 
 Clause 9.6 of the Agreement is hereby revised and replaced as follows: 
 “9.6 In order to enable Zameen to fully and properly perform the Services, the Customer hereby grants the exclusive right and authorizes Zameen to collect, for and on behalf of the Customer, down payment/instalment(s) up to thirty- three percent (3 3 %) of the Sale Price from the Buyer of any Unit included in Project’s Inventory and sold or booked during the Service Period or such other time period as may be mutually agreed with respect to the Units’ pending approvals. Pursuant to the above, the Customer hereby authorizes Zameen Medallion to collect the aforementioned payments through a bank instrument issued in favour of Zameen Medallion (Private) Limited or through direct bank transfer/deposit by the Buyer in the designated bank account of Zameen Medallion (Private) Limited specified in Annexure G. ” 
 
 Clause 9.8 of the Agreement is hereby revised and replaced as follows: 
 “9.8 Customer agrees that Zameen shall not be liable in any manner for any delay or failure on the part of the Buyer to make any payment/instalment up to thirty-three percent (3 3 %) of the Sale Price.” 
 Clause 9. 9 of the Agreement is hereby revised and replaced as follows: 
 “9. 9 In the event that the complete down payment (up to thirty- t hree percen t (3 3 %) of the Sale Price) with respect to any Unit sold or booked during the Service Period is not received from the Buyer at the time of termination of the Project Agreement, the Customer grants Zameen the right to collect the remaining down-payment from such Buyer(s) to enable Zameen to fulfil its obligations under Clause 5 above. For the avoidance of doubt, the Customer shall be liable to pay to Zameen the applicable Service Fee (defined below) with respect to such Units in accordance with the Project Agreement . ” 
 This Fi fth Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement. 
 All other terms and provisions in the Agreement shall apply mutatis mutandis and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict, the provisions of the Fi fth Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting term in the Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately. 
 All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement shall bear the same meaning in the Fi fth Amendment unless otherwise specified herein. 
 The Fi fth Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same amendment. 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this Fi fth Amendment, having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.
